features.feature: Replacement text at marked-content property lists and structure elements, with empty distinct from absent
features.source_location: §14.9.4 physical 815–816 / printed 800–801; Table 355 physical 740–741 / printed 725–726; §7.9.2.2 physical 131–132 / printed 116–117 (text-string type)
features.effective_source: A structure element can carry optional ActualText; a marked-content property list can carry ActualText under Span, and EC3 #483 adds an Artifact property-list location. A present value 'shall be used as a replacement' and is a character substitution. The clauses state no empty-string carve-out. () is a valid zero-byte PDF string object, while an absent key supplies no value.
features.ledger: 14.9.4 implemented; ledger describes all three routes and the nonempty replacement semantics but does not discuss zero-length strings
features.implementation: crates/pdf-model/src/structure.rs::text_entry returns None for every decoded empty string, including ActualText; crates/pdf-model/src/content/marked.rs::accessibility independently drops empty property-list ActualText before structure fallback; crates/pdf-model/src/content/run/marked_ops.rs treats Some(replacement) as the condition to cut enclosed text.
features.assertions: Existing positive assertions cover nonempty property-list ActualText, Artifact property-list ActualText, and nonempty structure-element ActualText. No actual empty ActualText case was found in current `crates/pdf-model` tests. Draft `drafts/empty_actualtext.rs` has separate exact-xref/no-recovery tests for Span, Artifact, and structure-element routes. Each compares absent, nonempty `(-)`, and empty `()` ActualText on a line-end hyphen; the structure test has one MCID, and property-list fixtures have no structure tree or MCID. Positive glyph counts show extraction changes without deleting page marks.
features.verdict: Concrete likely reader gap for ActualText: with an explicit empty string, the current implementation treats the entry as absent and preserves the marked line-end hyphen and inferred line break; the normative replacement rule points to removing those characters and joining the word. This does not concern structure scope/cardinality B12.
features.residuals: Draft is not compiled or executed. It checks extracted line joining and retained glyph count, not rendered raster equality. Structure ActualText is exercised through one direct MCID only.

features.feature: Alternate descriptions at a structure element or Span property list
features.effective_source: A structure Alt is a whole-word or phrase substitution for its current element; a property-list Alt may be on a Span sequence. Alt is spoken as accessible description and does not replace the text used for extraction. EC3 contains no relevant empty-value change located in this scope.
features.implementation: structure::text_entry and MarkedContent::accessibility both discard decoded empty strings. Nonempty property-list Alt is covered by accessibility.rs tests; nonempty structure Alt has structure tests and public accessibility consumers.
features.empty_semantics: The source does not state what an empty description means. Since it calls Alt a complete word or phrase, empty may be invalid producer data; no exact reader result or mandatory refusal follows from the reviewed text. No defect is claimed and no speculative empty-Alt test is drafted.
features.residuals: Empty Alt reader policy remains unspecified in the reviewed clauses.

features.feature: Expansion of abbreviations/acronyms at a structure element or Span property list
features.effective_source: An expansion may be specified as a structure-element E or Span property-list E. The E value is a word or phrase substitution and shall have word breaks on both sides. It changes spoken form, not extracted text. No relevant EC3 empty-value amendment was found.
features.implementation: structure::text_entry and MarkedContent::accessibility discard decoded empty strings. Nonempty property-list E and structure E have ordinary expansion coverage.
features.empty_semantics: The source gives no explicit empty-string rule. A zero-length value is not a word or phrase; whether the producer has supplied invalid input and what a reader should say are not specified here. No ActualText semantics are transferred to E.
features.residuals: Empty E reader policy is unreviewed/unspecified; no required behavior is asserted.
